local_color.name: The Long Layover
local_color.description: A dense strip of bars, diners, capsule hotels, laundries and crew services along an old freight concourse. Captains can find a meal at almost any species' preferred humidity and gravity orientation.

local_color.name: The Spare Room
local_color.description: Started when a mechanic rented an unused pressure module to stranded crews. Expansion added rooms one module at a time; none match.

local_color.name: Survey House
local_color.description: Part permit desk, part chart room, part message board. Crews compare route notes here before leaving dependable navigation coverage.

local_color.name: Container City
local_color.description: Hundreds of freight containers and prefabricated habitat modules converted into housing, clinics, workshops and food stalls while permanent construction lags behind population growth.

local_color.name: Manufacturer Row
local_color.description: Showrooms, warehouses, certification shops and parts counters representing manufacturers from across known space. Captains routinely compare components here before committing to a refit.

local_color.name: Second Life Market
local_color.description: A sprawling market for repaired appliances, furniture, suits, tools and ship components. In Carver, throwing away something serviceable is considered financially eccentric.

local_color.name: Old Load Hall
local_color.description: A still-operating freight hall whose original structural frame predates modern interstellar standards. Successive generations adapted standardized docks around it rather than demolishing it.

local_color.name: The Hanging Works
local_color.description: A propulsion manufacturing complex suspended across a deep escarpment, exploiting Ilos's low gravity and dense atmosphere for material movement and testing.

local_color.name: Nine Currents Exchange
local_color.description: A partly submerged commercial district where freight, aquaculture products and environmental technology change hands between surface, floating and underwater transport.

local_color.name: Warm Junction
local_color.description: A crowded underground interchange where public transit, machine access corridors, food stalls and thermal infrastructure occupy the same interconnected volume.
